assertions.description: The API this property is added to.
The interface carrying the new property. Its members can be read without a controller connected, which is what makes this feature probeable on any machine.
The three properties that exist today. They describe a button's state completely and say nothing about its identity, which is the gap this feature fills.
The feature: a button names itself, so a control past the seventeen standard positions can be identified without matching on the device id string.
The two members an application currently reasons about: a free-text id, and whether the standard mapping applies. Both must exist for the workaround this feature replaces to be describable at all.

Calling it with nothing connected must return a list rather than throwing, so a page can probe the API on any machine. A browser also withholds gamepads until the user has interacted with one, which is why every demo here degrades rather than waiting.
